in_sanskrit.name: Bandhula
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bond, Connection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bandhula एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bandhula is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'bandh' meaning 'to bind' or 'to attach'. It signifies a strong bond, connection, or relationship. In Hindu mythology, Bandhula is an epithet of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, symbolizing her role in creating and sustaining relationships and connections.
